question: Rashmi Samant is the first Indian woman to occupy the position of president of _____________ Student Union in Feb, 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oxford**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rashmi Samant became the first Indian woman to be elected as the president of the Oxford University Student Union in February 2021.
 
• Her election was historic as it marked significant representation for Indian students at the prestigious university.
 
• Her election was one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in the world, had never before had an Indian woman leading its student body.
 
• Samant campaigned on themes such as inclusivity, environmental issues, and mental health support for students, which resonated with many at Oxford.
 
• Her win was celebrated by many in India and internationally as a step forward for diversity and representation in educational institutions globally.
 
• However, her presidency was brief, as she faced scrutiny and criticism over some past social media posts, which eventually led her to step down from the role.
